producer_report.summary: I added a typed decision view (decisions.rs) and a committed list of all 24 supersession and amend hits (docs/decision-links.toml). `athena backtest` condition (a) now compares the parsed hits with that list instead of the two hard-coded pairs. A hit missing from the list, or listed but not found in the log, is a finding. The new test that parses the real docs/decisions.md finds no condition (a) finding. I did not run conditions (b) to (d). They need records/, which I couldn't read. fmt and clippy pass, and `cargo test --locked` exited 0. I did not read its full output, which was truncated, so the exit status is my evidence for the full run. The test run before the last small fix to one test assertion showed all new tests passing. Each entry's view has id, status (active or superseded), `superseded_by` and `amended_by`. The list's status decides, not the log's wording: D11 by D39 (line 322) is amended and stays active. D87 by D88 is amended on both lines (1909 and 1930). D46 by D79 is superseded (lines 1028 and 1760). The prose-only hits from D48 on are amended. No brief, defaults.toml, BRIEF.md or decisions.md prose changed. I marked §8 step 2 built in decision-sets.md and added CHANGELOG entries. I also updated the Backtest doc comment in main.rs.

checks_run.note: command exited 0; output was truncated so I did not read every line. Earlier `cargo test -p athena-cli` showed all new tests pass after fixing one wrong assertion of mine.

open_issues: Only D11/D39 is confirmed by the user by name. The other 23 hits in docs/decision-links.toml come from the parse and are for the user to confirm. D46 to D79 is marked superseded (full), per its text.
The D06 target of line 1287 is not a parsed hit (existing parse behaviour, noted in the list and the design doc). Fixing the parse is a separate change.
Conditions (b) to (d) depend on records/ and were not run here.
`athena backtest` now errors if docs/decision-links.toml is missing.
mistakes: My first real-log test asserted the last view entry is D90; the log ends at D91. Fixed to check that D90 is present.
learnings: docs/decisions.md has entries through D91, not D90.
The parse gives 24 hits on the real log, matching §9. Line 1287 'Amends D39's exemption list and D06' yields only D39, because the list parse stops after the id followed by "'s".
Line numbers in docs/decision-links.toml are tied to the current docs/decisions.md; any edit that shifts lines needs the list updated.
crates/athena-cli/Cargo.toml needed no change: serde and toml were already dependencies.
desires: A way to read the persisted tool output when a command's output is truncated.
